bio: Maria and Lois Stern have been welcoming diners to their restaurant in a traffic-reduced zone in the centre of Kitzbühel since 1994 and have built up a loyal following. An inviting atmosphere reigns in the modern interior. The focal point is the open kitchen, where the chef-patron cooks up Asian-European fusion dishes. The quality of the ingredients is excellent. In addition to the regular menu, there are daily specials. The friendly proprietress and her well-trained team provide attentive service....
